summary: Quiet Hours lets the user set a start time and an end time for a daily quiet period and shows whether the current local time falls inside that period, including when the period crosses midnight. The two times are stored on the device and restored after restart.
targetUsers: People who want a simple on-screen indicator of whether the current time is within their quiet hours
People whose quiet period spans midnight and need an indicator that handles that case
goals: Let the user set a start time and an end time for quiet hours
Show whether the current time is inside the quiet hours, including periods that cross midnight
Persist the two times on the device and restore them after restart
nonGoals: Scheduling notifications or silencing system sounds

features.name: Quiet hours settings and status
features.userOutcome: The user sets a start time and an end time and sees whether the current time is inside quiet hours, including when the period crosses midnight.
features.trigger: The user opens the app and changes the start or end time.
features.behavior: The main screen shows a start time input and an end time input, both defaulting to 22:00 and 07:00, and a status area. The user picks a start time and an end time; each change is saved immediately. The status area shows 'Inside quiet hours' when the current local time is within the period and 'Outside quiet hours' otherwise. The period is computed as: if start is before end, inside means current time is at or after start and before end; if start is after end, the period crosses midnight and inside means current time is at or after start or before end; if start equals end, the period is treated as empty and the status is 'Outside quiet hours'. The status refreshes every second while the app is open. On launch the stored start and end times are loaded and the status is computed from them.
features.failureOutcome: If the stored times cannot be read, the app falls back to the defaults 22:00 and 07:00 and continues showing status.
acceptanceSignals: With start 22:00 and end 07:00 and the current local time 23:30, the status area shows 'Inside quiet hours'.
With start 22:00 and end 07:00 and the current local time 12:00, the status area shows 'Outside quiet hours'.
With start 22:00 and end 07:00 and the current local time 06:59, the status area shows 'Inside quiet hours'.
With start 22:00 and end 07:00 and the current local time 07:00, the status area shows 'Outside quiet hours'.
With start 09:00 and end 17:00 and the current local time 09:00, the status area shows 'Inside quiet hours'.
With start 09:00 and end 09:00, the status area shows 'Outside quiet hours' at every time of day.
After changing the start time to 21:00 and restarting the app, the start time input shows 21:00.
The status area updates at least once per second while the app is open.

dataObjects.name: Quiet hours settings
dataObjects.purpose: Stores the user's quiet hours start time and end time on the device.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device so the times are restored after restart.

qualityRequirements: The status area reflects the current local time with at most one second of lag while the app is open.
The inside/outside decision handles periods that cross midnight and periods where start equals end.
productConstraints: Only a single daily quiet period is supported.
The app does not silence system sounds or send notifications.
